records.unlock_condition: Complete PQ 35 (Miscalculations in Time); independent player reports identify PQ 35 as the immediate prerequisite.
win_conditions: Defeat Piccolo and Goku before Gohan
records.ultimate_finish_trigger: Defeat Piccolo and Goku before Gohan, then defeat Gohan while Cell survives.

records.notes: A newer independently maintained datamined corpus claims PQ36 was cut and the numbering skips 35 to 37, while the long-running game-specific reward transcription and multiple independent objective guides document PQ36 as an actual quest. Independent player evidence also reports that completing PQ35 unlocks PQ36. The quest is retained with the numbering conflict explicit rather than silently deleted.
